headline: Indian Markets Face Resistance Near 26,000 as Volatility Declines
summary: India's Nifty index experienced selling pressure near the psychological 26,000 level, ending the week lower following a period of consolidation within a range.
why: Benchmark equity indices reflect broader domestic market sentiment and investor participation across listed securities.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Selling pressure near key resistance levels caused the benchmark index to close lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The index encountered heavy selling pressure near the 26,000 resistance level after a recent recovery, failing to sustain gains and consolidating within a narrow range.
